signals.headline: As the US pauses the war with Iran, is Trump really running out of weapons?
signals.summary: When US President Donald Trump took the stage earlier this month at the Pennsylvania Defense and Innovation Summit, flanked by the CEOs of some of America's largest defence firms, he had one message in mind: build more weapons, and build them faster.
keyTakeaways: Is the US really running out of weapons under Trump?
The Trump administration framed the summit as part of a two-pronged approach to revitalise American industry and bolster US warfighting capabilities and, in Hegseth's words, its "arsenal of freedom".
Now, the US has paused its strikes on Iran to allow negotiations to go ahead.
signals.whyItMatters: A New York Times report says that Trump was advised to shelve plans to escalate the conflict as it would further drain American stockpiles.

ja.headline: 対イラン攻撃を一時停止——米国の兵器備蓄は本当に限界なのか
ja.summary: トランプ大統領は今月、ペンシルベニア州で開かれた防衛・イノベーション・サミットに主要防衛企業のCEOたちを従えて登壇し、兵器の増産と生産加速を訴えた。
keyTakeaways: トランプ政権下で、米国の兵器備蓄は実際に逼迫しているのか
サミットは、米国の産業再生と戦闘能力の強化——ヘグセス長官の言葉を借りれば「自由の兵器庫」の拡充——という二本柱の取り組みとして位置づけられた
その後、米国はイランへの攻撃を一時停止し、交渉の余地を残した
ja.whyItMatters: ニューヨーク・タイムズの報道によれば、トランプ大統領は側近から、紛争のエスカレートは米国の備蓄をさらに消耗させるとして、計画の棚上げを進言されていたという。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So Trump just paused strikes on Iran. Is the US actually running low on weapons?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It's a real concern. A New York Times report says Trump was advised that escalating the conflict would further drain American stockpiles.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: That's surprising. I thought the US had huge military reserves.

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It does, but recent conflicts have put pressure on supplies. Earlier this month, Trump held a summit with defense company CEOs, pushing them to build more weapons faster.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What was that summit about exactly?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: The administration called it a two-pronged approach: revitalize American industry and boost warfighting capabilities. They're calling it the arsenal of freedom.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So the pause with Iran is partly about letting stockpiles recover?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: That seems to be part of it. The pause is officially to allow negotiations to go ahead, but the weapons concern appears to be a factor in the timing.

signals.headline: Ben Carroll announces royal commission into construction sector in first act as new Victorian premier
signals.summary: Ben Carroll has been sworn in as the premier of Victoria after Jacinta Allan resigned, with his first act as leader to announce a royal commission into alleged corruption in the construction sector.
keyTakeaways: Carroll’s elevation comes just four months before the state election and follows a tumultuous 48 hours for Labor, during which Allan resigned and a surprise challenger emerged in the leadership contest.
Carroll, who at a press conference in June looked Allan in the eye and declared he would not challenge her, said “circumstances had changed”.
This delegation had already visited the premier and informed her that they wanted change.
signals.whyItMatters: After her announcement, it was expected that Carroll would run unopposed for the leadership during Tuesday’s caucus meeting, but the meeting descended into chaos when the attorney general, Sonya Kilkenny – a key supporter of Allan’s – put her hand up for the leadership.

ja.headline: ビクトリア州に新首相、就任初日に建設業界の王立委員会設置を表明
ja.summary: ジャシンタ・アランの辞任を受け、ベン・キャロルがビクトリア州首相に就任した。キャロルは就任直後、建設業界における汚職疑惑を調査する王立委員会の設置を表明している。
keyTakeaways: 就任は州議会選挙の四か月前というタイミングで、労働党にとって激動の四十八時間の末に実現した
六月の記者会見でアランを前に「挑戦しない」と明言していたキャロルは、「状況が変わった」と述べた
代議員団はすでにアラン前首相のもとを訪れ、交代を求めていた
ja.whyItMatters: アランの辞任表明後、キャロルが無投票で党首に選出されると見られていたが、アランの有力な支持者だった司法長官ソーニャ・キルケニーが名乗りを上げ、党内会合は混乱に陥った。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So Victoria has a new premier this morning?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, Ben Carroll was sworn in after Jacinta Allan resigned. It all happened very quickly.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: And this is just months before an election, right?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Exactly. Four months. It follows a really turbulent couple of days for Labor.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What's his first move as premier?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: He's announced a royal commission into alleged corruption in the construction sector.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Wasn't there some drama around how he became leader?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: There was. Back in June, he publicly said he wouldn't challenge Allan. But he says circumstances changed.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What changed exactly?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: A group within the party had already told Allan they wanted change. Then at Tuesday's meeting, the attorney general Sonya Kilkenny unexpectedly ran against him.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So it wasn't the smooth transition people expected.

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Not at all. The meeting descended into chaos, according to reports.

signals.headline: X Money is launching in the US starting today
signals.summary: X Money, a core part of Elon Musk’s mission to turn X into an “ everything app,” is rolling out starting today, 9to5Mac reports.
keyTakeaways: Other perks include Apple Wallet support and free money transfers on X.
The launch comes a few months after Elon Musk said “early public access” for the payment platform was launching in April.
signals.whyItMatters: The payment platform offers a digital wallet and peer-to-peer payments similar to Venmo, along with a metal Visa card users can emblazon with their X username.

ja.headline: Xのデジタルウォレットサービスがアメリカで始動
ja.summary: イーロン・マスクがXを「なんでもアプリ」にするという構想の核となる決済サービス、X Moneyが本日より米国でのロールアウトを開始した。9to5Macが伝えた。
keyTakeaways: Apple Walletへの対応と、X上での無料送金機能も提供される。
マスク氏が4月に一般向け早期アクセスを開始すると述べてから、数か月を経ての正式始動となった。
ja.whyItMatters: このサービスはVenmoに近いデジタルウォレットと個人間送金に加え、自分のXユーザー名を刻印できるメタル製Visaカードも用意されている。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So X is launching a payment service now?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, X Money is rolling out in the US starting today. It's part of Elon Musk's plan to turn X into what he calls an everything app.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What does it actually do?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It offers a digital wallet and peer-to-peer payments, similar to Venmo. You can also get a metal Visa card that can have your X username on it.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Are there any special features?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: A couple things stand out. It supports Apple Wallet, and money transfers on X are free.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Didn't Musk mention this was coming earlier?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: He did. He said early public access would launch in April, so this is a few months after that timeline.

signals.headline: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked 2026: The 6 biggest announcements
signals.summary: Samsung’s annual summer event kicked off on Wednesday morning with the company unveiling a new lineup of watches and foldables.
keyTakeaways: If you weren’t able to watch the event yourself, you can catch up with all of this year’s biggest Galaxy Unpacked announcements below.
The new Fold also features an updated hinge design with Samsung’s new Flex Titanium display tech.
It doesn’t completely eliminate the crease on the inside display, but it does make it significantly less noticeable than the crease on Samsung’s previous foldables.
signals.whyItMatters: The highlight of Galaxy Unpacked was the Galaxy Z Fold 8, which got a major redesign from last year’s Z Fold 7.

ja.headline: サムスンが新型折りたたみスマートフォンと時計を発表
ja.summary: サムスンは夏恒例の発表イベントを水曜日に開催し、新ラインナップの折りたたみスマートフォンとスマートウォッチを公開した。
keyTakeaways: イベントを見逃した人も、今年の主な発表内容をまとめて確認できる。
新型Foldは、サムスン独自のFlex Titaniumディスプレイ技術を採用した改良ヒンジを搭載。
内側ディスプレイの折り目が完全に消えたわけではないが、従来モデルと比べて明らかに目立たなくなっている。
ja.whyItMatters: 今回の目玉はGalaxy Z Fold 8で、昨年のZ Fold 7から大幅にデザインが刷新された。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So Samsung had their big summer event yesterday?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, Galaxy Unpacked happened Wednesday morning. They showed off new watches and foldable phones.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What was the main thing they announced?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 was the highlight. It got a major redesign from last year's Z Fold 7.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What's different about it?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It has an updated hinge design with something called Flex Titanium display tech.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Does that fix the crease issue those phones have?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It doesn't eliminate it completely, but Samsung says the crease is significantly less noticeable than on their previous foldables.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Were there other announcements too?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, there were six major announcements total, including the new watches they mentioned. The full lineup is available if you want to catch up on what you missed.

signals.headline: How to see July's full Buck Moon as it rises in the night sky
signals.summary: The July full Moon, also known as the Buck Moon, will light up the night sky across the UK on Wednesday.
keyTakeaways: The second of three full Moons this summer, it is set to peak at 15:36 BST on 29 July.
The exact moment of its maximum fullness will be missed across the UK as the Moon will be just below the horizon.
Why is it called the Buck Moon?
signals.whyItMatters: Across north-west England and Wales the remnants of a cold weather front might obscure the sky, but very little rain is expected and the cloud could break.

ja.headline: 7月の満月「バック・ムーン」、夜空に昇る
ja.summary: 7月の満月は「バック・ムーン」とも呼ばれ、水曜日の夜、英国の空を明るく照らす。
keyTakeaways: 今夏三度の満月のうち二度目で、最大の満月の瞬間は日本時間29日23時36分ごろ。
満月のピークは地平線の下にあたるため、英国では肉眼でその瞬間を捉えることはできない。
「バック・ムーン」という名は、この時期に雄鹿の角が生え揃うことに由来する。
ja.whyItMatters: イングランド北西部とウェールズでは寒冷前線の残りが空を覆う可能性があるが、雨はほとんど見込まれず、雲の切れ間も期待できる。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So there's a full Moon coming up this week?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, on Wednesday. It's called the Buck Moon, and it's the second of three full Moons this summer.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Buck Moon? That's an interesting name.

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It is. The name comes from the time of year when male deer grow their antlers.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: When's the best time to see it?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It actually peaks at 15:36 in the afternoon, so across the UK, the Moon will still be below the horizon at that exact moment.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So we'll miss the peak fullness?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Technically, yes. But it'll still look beautifully full when it rises Wednesday evening.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Any weather concerns for viewing?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: In north-west England and Wales, there might be some cloud from a cold front, but very little rain is expected and the cloud could break up.
